title: 冬休みのライン画
subject_en: Winter holiday scenes and objects drawn as clean black line art for colouring, each ONE motif centred in its cell, plain white inside every shape, all contours closed. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: こたつ・雪だるま・雪遊び・大掃除・餅つきなど、冬休みの場面と道具を線画で描いた12点です。冬休みの課題やおたより、ぬりえに使えます。
items: a kotatsu table with a blanket, a bowl of mandarin oranges and a cat curled beside it
a snowman with a bucket hat, a scarf, stick arms and a carrot nose
a child on a sled going down a snowy hill (simple faced child, mittens and a hat)
a pair of ice skates with laces and a few snowflakes
two children throwing snowballs at each other in warm coats
a bucket, a mop and a duster arranged together
a wooden mortar with a mallet and round rice cakes
a child writing a postcard at a desk with a brush pen
a mug of hot cocoa with steam and a marshmallow, with a knitted scarf beside
a pair of mittens, a scarf and a knit hat
three large detailed snowflakes of different shapes
a stack of notebooks with a pencil and an eraser and a calendar page
